optionalMotionRules.roarMeaning: special intimidation or vocalization, NEVER substitute for guard

rules.description: Keep approved face, costume, proportions and weapon/armor appearance across every frame
rules.action: Compare contact sheets with approved source visually before release

rules.description: One character, exactly one motion, eight sequential key poses; no mixed-action boards
No duplicated silhouettes, ghost limbs, multiple monsters in one frame
rules.action: Fail ambiguous merged components and request re-generation

rules.description: Extract connected alpha regions, not rectangle crop with foreign neighboring pixels
rules.action: Select center actor, preserve connected limbs and local accessories

rules.description: Keep full tails, claws, helmets, shields and weapons inside enlarged X and Y gutters
rules.action: Widen source frame canvas instead of shrinking artwork

rules.description: Same scale across all eight frames; anchor stable feet
rules.action: Use stable planted feet, never per-frame recenter or zoom

rules.description: Attack anticipation and advance, recoil backward, leap arc; no accidental frame bobbing
rules.action: Render animation GIF with frame DX/DY and inspect displacement

rules.description: Guard required; roar extra, not replacement
Card preview uses idle animation, never separate still thumbnail
rules.action: Use 8-frame idle canvas with no still art

rules.description: Selected card may play roar once; standoff may play roar with cooldown if actual art exists
rules.action: Never fake roar by reusing an attack pose

rules.description: Death plays all 8 frames and holds last frame
Do not replace approved production sprites without full coverage and browser validation
rules.action: Preserve old manifest until safe deployment
